expectationBasis: The visitor starts at the application home page in a fresh unauthenticated browser session. The system pre-provisions public repository `acme-docs` with an accessible commit entry and changed file `src/search.ts`; the visitor can open the commit entry without signing in.
The commit detail displays `src/search.ts`, a “Changed files” summary, and numeric additions and deletions.

uncoveredOutcomes.reason: The seed declarations and requirement text do not state the numeric addition count for the seeded commit, so no literal expected text or value exists; the literal-only assertion DSL cannot assert that additions are numeric without the expected number, and inventing a number would assert a value the evidence does not declare.

The seed declarations and requirement text do not state the numeric deletion count for the seeded commit, so no literal expected text or value exists; the literal-only assertion DSL cannot assert that deletions are numeric without the expected number, and inventing a number would assert a value the evidence does not declare.
